title: Stock Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for December, 21st (AAPL, ALXN, CVIA, DCI, EA, GPP, GTHX, JWN, LMT, LOXO)
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Dec 21st, 2018 // No Comments
Stock Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Friday, December 21st:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.. Get Apple Inc alerts:
Alexion Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:ALXN) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Raymond James.
Covia (NASDAQ:CVIA) was downgraded by analysts at OTR Global from a positive rating to a negative rating.
Donaldson (NYSE:DCI) had its hold rating reaffirmed by analysts at Robert W. Baird. They currently have a $52.00 target price on the stock.
Electronic Arts (NASDAQ:EA) had its overweight rating reiterated by analysts at Wedbush. The firm currently has a $133.00 target price on the stock.
Green Plains Partners (NASDAQ:GPP) was downgraded by analysts at Wells Fargo & Co from an outperform rating to a market perform rating. The firm currently has $18.00 price target on the stock.
G1 Therapeutics (NASDAQ:GTHX) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Cowen Inc.
Nordstrom (NYSE:JWN) had its overweight rating reissued by analysts at Wedbush. They currently have a $75.00 target price on the stock.
Lockheed Martin (NYSE:LMT) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Robert W. Baird. They currently have a $326.00 target price on the stock.
Oppenheimer Holdings Inc. assumed coverage on shares of Loxo Oncology (NASDAQ:LOXO) . They issued a buy rating and a $185.00 target price on the stock.
U.S. Silica (NYSE:SLCA) was downgraded by analysts at OTR Global from a positive rating to a negative rating.
TransUnion (NYSE:TRU) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Robert W. Baird. Robert W. Baird currently has a $73.00 target price on the stock.
Grupo Televisa SAB (NYSE:TV) was upgraded by analysts at Santander from a hold rating to a buy rating.
Telefonica Brasil (NYSE:VIV) was upgraded by analysts at Santander from a hold rating to a buy rating.
